prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a photoreal 4:5 1960s-inspired retro interior portrait of an adult woman with long straight platinum-blonde hair, blue eyes, red lips, and soft natural makeup. She wears an orange ribbed long-sleeve blouse with a high crew neckline, high-waisted orange-and-cream floral wide-leg trousers, and dark-brown embroidered cowboy boots. Pose her sitting sideways on a low stool beside a large vintage wooden tube-radio cabinet, one hand on the cabinet edge and the other holding a folded plain handkerchief. Include dusty-pink pleated curtains, parquet floor, and a cream speaker grille with analog dial markings too abstract to read. Use soft even natural indoor light, a slightly desaturated nostalgic palette, fine film grain, and no text, logos, or watermark.
